rows.text: with `o` = `rcx`: `v` = `0030CA50(o)`; returns when `v` + 1 is at most 1 (unsigned, so `v` is 0 or -1); for i below dword [o+0x77C] (signed, re-read each step), when `p` = qword [o+0x780+16i] and then `e` = `00263E30(p)` are non-null, appends dword [e+8] to a 32-dword stack array (no bound on the count `n`); when `n` is non-zero calls `002EAD00(dword [o+8], n, array, v)` and, when `00237420()` returns non-zero, `0024ED50(v)` (stack cookie `01F44830` checked by `00808C40`)
